findings.message: qryListarMeusAvisos filters by dataInicio/dataFim but no state holds them. Added public draft states filtroDataInicio and filtroDataFim with setters setFiltroDataInicio and setFiltroDataFim; qryListarMeusAvisos(page, append) reads them.

The param avisoVencimentoId selects an aviso but no member selected it. Added public selectAvisoVencimento(id | null), which publishes selectedAvisoVencimento (kept in the URL) and loads the record through qryAvisoPorId.

qryAvisoPorId returns 'aviso' but no state has qryAvisoPorId.aviso as its source. Its output is written to avisoAtual, the state that feeds avisoDoDia. Clearing the selection sets avisoAtual to null without reloading.
public filtroDataFim is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
